title: Integral elements are almost integral; over a Noetherian domain conversely (Stacks 00GX)
statement: Let $R$ be an integral domain with field of fractions $K$, and let $g\in K$. (1) If $g$ is integral over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], then $g$ is almost integral over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-almost-integral]: there is $r\in R$, $r\ne0$, with $rg^n\in R$ for all $n\ge0$. (2) If $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $g$ is almost integral over $R$, then $g$ is integral over $R$.
